custom_preconds:
Custom role provisioned: Work Orders = View (Create & Edit OFF, Delete OFF), Work Order Lines = View only, Pick Parts sub-toggle = ON.
A confirmed staff user is assigned that role.
A Work Order exists (admin-seeded) with one authorized-to-repair line and one inventory-sourced part request in in_stock status.
The regression assertion also provisions a second role with Work Orders = View and Pick Parts / Order Parts / WO Lines Create & Edit all OFF.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log the Pick-Parts custom-role user into the app and open the seeded Work Order.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Work Order detail renders (status badge visible).

custom_steps_separated.content: Switch to the Part Requests tab and expand the line.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The part request row and its Quantity cell (input_quantity_<id>) are visible.

custom_steps_separated.content: Read the Quantity input's disabled state.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Quantity input is ENABLED (editable) for the Pick-Parts role despite Work Orders Create & Edit being OFF.

custom_steps_separated.content: Change the quantity to a new value, blur to trigger auto-save, then reload and re-open the Part Requests tab.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The new quantity persists (change-request saved server-side).

custom_steps_separated.content: Regression: log in the View-only role with no part sub-toggles, open the same Work Order's Part Requests tab, and read the Quantity input.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Quantity input is DISABLED for a role holding none of {Work Orders Create & Edit, WO Lines Create & Edit, Pick Parts, Order Parts}.

title: Part Requests tab Quantity editable for Pick/Order Parts custom role
